nodes.description: Public pure function getLabel(uint256 slot) that maps a slot index to a color name string and returns it.
Public pure function getData(uint256 slot) that maps a slot index to a hex color code and returns SVG bytes via abi.encodePacked.
Input parameter slot of getLabel, used with modulo 24 to index the in-memory names array.
In-memory fixed-size array of 24 color name strings declared inside getLabel.
Input parameter slot of getData, used with modulo 24 to index the in-memory colors array.
In-memory fixed-size array of 24 hex color code strings declared inside getData.

edges.reason: The slot parameter flows into getLabel where it is bounded by slot % names.length and used to select the returned color name.
The in-memory names array is read inside getLabel and its selected element is returned to the caller.
The slot parameter flows into getData where it is bounded by slot % colors.length and used to select the color code.
The in-memory colors array is read inside getData and concatenated into the returned ABI-encoded bytes.

normalization_plan.reason: The slot parameter has no independent security role outside getLabel, so it is merged into the getLabel function node.
The names local array is only used within getLabel, so it collapses into the getLabel function node.
The slot parameter has no independent security role outside getData, so it is merged into the getData function node.
The colors local array is only used within getData, so it collapses into the getData function node.
